passage: Last month, my friend and I took a train to the mountains. The train left at eight in the morning and arrived at noon. We sat by the window and watched the fields go by. There were cows, small houses, and long rivers. It was a beautiful ride. When we arrived, the air was cool and fresh. We walked to a small hotel near the lake. The hotel was old but clean, and the owner was very kind. In the afternoon, we climbed a hill behind the hotel. It took us two hours to reach the top. From the top, we could see the whole lake and the mountains far away. We were tired but happy. In the evening, we ate noodles at a small restaurant. The food was hot and cheap. That night, we slept early because we wanted to watch the sunrise.
